data.name: Gas handling system
data.function: Cabinet holding the pumps, valves, gauges and traps that store, circulate, and clean the 3He/4He mixture. Its mimic panel is the operator's view of the fridge state machine: pumping the vacuum can, pre-cooling with the pulse tube, condensing the mixture, running at base, and warming up. Every valve state below is a node of that state machine.

physics.summary: Stores and circulates the helium mixture; hosts the cooldown state machine.

data.tooltip: Gas handling cabinet with the mixture circuit.
